mvkObserved.operationComparison: Both native source and preserved MVK3 generated Ground FS sample minimap before selecting explosion-only color contribution; both use atlas color and normal, terrain normal, shadow compare/color, and projection/depth reconstruction. Native GameDecal FS and MVK generated GameDecal FS both perform atlas/minimap/normal/LOS/shadow-related work. These are source-level correspondences, not matched GPU timing or proof of a backend-specific difference.

rankedCandidates.name: Ground decal indexed cube corners
rankedCandidates.concreteChange: Use a fixed 36-entry uint16 index sequence naming the eight existing effective corner vertex IDs, preserving triangle order and the current cyclic provoking-vertex rotation; retain current VS/FS math and all fragment resources.
rankedCandidates.evidence: Current native draw submits 36 vertices for each of 32364 instances. CUBE_VERT has eight distinct corners; GroundDecalVertex calls Run((vid/3)*3+(vid%3+2)%3), and Run uses the source ID only to read relPos, so duplicate effective corners produce equal outputs for the same instance. First effective-vertex representatives are [0,1,2,5,6,7,8,11]. MVK saved ground draw also has 12 triangles/36 vertices per instance; this is shared geometry work, not a native-specific backend gap.
rankedCandidates.potential: Targets the observed 9.3242% GroundDecalVertex shader-cost share; eight distinct corner results versus 36 submitted vertices per instance. Actual hardware vertex-cache reuse and replay cost reduction are unmeasured.
rankedCandidates.guard: Prove exact index sequence preserves each ordered triangle, all varying outputs including flat glow/provoking semantics, and native color/depth/stencil parity; inspect indexed vertex_id semantics and allocation lifetime. No raster-quality or fragment algorithm change.

rankedCandidates.name: Explosion-only minimap sample in Ground FS
rankedCandidates.concreteChange: Conditionally sample miniMapTex only for vDecalType == DECAL_EXPLOSION; leave all non-explosion color math and explosion branch intact.
rankedCandidates.evidence: NativeGroundDecalShaders.h:730 samples miniMapTex unconditionally; lines 735-737 select mixed color only for explosion. Preserved MVK generated Ground FS lines 179-181 also sample before type select.
rankedCandidates.potential: Can avoid one texture read for non-explosion fragments if the compiler and hardware preserve the condition. The captured instance-type distribution and fragment coverage are unavailable; this is not a quantified cost reduction.
rankedCandidates.guard: Check NaN/selection behavior, derivative/texture sampling semantics and full color/depth/stencil parity. Branch divergence and compiler scheduling could offset savings.

limits: Shader-cost percentages are relative costs within one replay, not milliseconds, frame shares, or additive cross-run quantities.
Native and MVK3 captures are different moments and binary stacks; no direct timing ratio or isolated backend causal claim.
No saved per-instance decal type distribution or fragment invocation counts, so fragment candidate cannot be sized.
A fixed indexed draw is a design candidate; no measured speedup or parity result exists.
